title: Near and Far · Quick round
hook: Find a game, gather your friends and start playing.

knows: The group wants an activity to play together.
doesNotKnow: The setup, turn and ending for this house-rule format.

misconception: The group has to know a complicated rulebook before starting.
objective: Learn how to play Near and Far · Quick round with friends.

claims.text: Original house rules: Choose a fixed standing or seated observation point and two visible objects at clearly different distances. The lead identifies which object is nearer to that observation point. The group agrees with the comparison from that point. Give each attempt 30 seconds. Each player leads two turns and earns one point per success. Highest score wins; ties are shared.
claims.source: Original playable house-rule proposal; not an authoritative ruleset for a traditional game.

claims.text: For this version: 2–8 players; materials: A timer.
claims.source: Proposed setup and player range for this activity.

recall.question: In Near and Far, what counts as a successful turn?
options: The group ends the round before anyone plays.
The group agrees with the comparison from that point.
The lead skips the turn without attempting it.
recall.why: The group agrees with the comparison from that point.
